name: vostride/agent-qa
summary: Application-QA workflow that connects natural-language test authoring, run evidence, failure triage, and scoped debug/fix through Agent Skills, a CLI, and MCP.
evidence: The README documents MCP and Agent Skills for coding agents and supports Codex subscription authentication.
Three bundled skills implement test authoring, evidence-backed result triage, and scoped debug/fix workflows.
The MCP interface exposes test definitions, run state, logs, artifacts, and failure classification to coding agents.
